page.overview:
Who is French Legionnaire?

The French Legionnaire was a minor character who appeared at the end of Casino Royale (1967 film).

During the fight at the end of the movie, the French Legionnaire arrived at Casino Royale and informs Sir James Bond that the French have arrived in his French accent, but he translates his message in English in his English translation book.

While punching a few people, the French Legionnaire goes from exclaiming "Ouch!" in French and translating it in his book. He was killed in the explosion caused by Dr. Noah after he swallowed an atomic bomb pill.
